messages.subject: For Thomas Schinecker | Global healthcare, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Roche Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Dr. Thomas Schinecker, Chief Executive Officer.

Roche's global healthcare platform operates across governments, regulators, health systems, communities and sustainability priorities. That environment aligns closely with my experience leading complex external and institutional relationships.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory, with senior institutional engagement across a regulated emerging-market operation.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, stakeholder strategy and emerging-market execution might support Roche's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Roche.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
